raw.query: SELECT metric_path, script, value_num FROM eda_metric WHERE metric_path IN ('numimages.share_text_only','classes.text.request_share','prefill_volume.share_of_requests_multimodal')
raw.evidence: The canonical text-only share is exactly 0.5, but the request-class taxonomy gives 50.0017%, so 'exactly 50.0%' is not robust across the two operational definitions of 'text-only'.
raw.fix: Pin the operational definition (num_images==0); if using the class taxonomy report 50.0017% or say 'approximately 50%'.
